name: ModelVariant89_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant89_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (a flash fan bursts from a model part, fifteen panels fly out to a 4x6 grid that fades in and rises in front of the slot, the panels gather back and a two-sided shell sweeps the slot while the screen fades from white); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request, packs the texture images and starts the delay, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 until the closing fade and lift begin, 1 once when they do, 2 after the panels have gathered and 0 otherwise; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-106 and 236 images build it from the same source with a 256-line flash; the order-table pad byte gModelVariant89_D242B is unbound, its value chosen per image by MODEL89_ORDER_PAD. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
